title: Kolyvagin's conjecture at non-ordinary primes
summary: Let $K$ be an imaginary quadratic field and let $p \ge 5$ be a prime that is unramified in $K$. Let $\mathcal{A}_f/\mathbb{Q}$ be an abelian variety of $\mathrm{GL}_2$-type associated with a weight-two modular form $f$, with good non-ordinary reduction at $p$, and suppose that $(f,K)$ satisfies the generalized Heegner hypothesis. In the case where $p$ is inert in $K$, we further assume that $\mathcal{A}_f$ is an elliptic curve.
